info.title: API.SH: MLB Stats
info.description: The MLB Stats API from API.SH: public MLB Stats data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The draft of a year: round, overall and round pick, team, player (position, birth date, bats/throws), school, signing bonus, pick value, scouting report and headshot. Filter by round and team.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-draft

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: MLB game box score and line score
get.description:
One game: line score by inning (runs, hits, errors, left on base), both teams' batting, pitching and fielding totals, every batter's and pitcher's line for the game with season stats, bench and bullpen, notes, umpires and game info (weather, attendance, duration ...). Pass the game id from `/mlb/v1/schedule`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-game

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Game id (gamePk) from /mlb/v1/schedule, or an mlb.com gameday link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: MLB league leaders by stat category
get.description:
The top players of a season in one or more categories (home runs, batting average, RBI, OPS, ERA, wins, saves, strikeouts, WHIP, stolen bases ...): rank, value, player, team and league. Filter by stat group, league and game type.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-leaders

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Leader category (default homeRuns); comma-separated for several, e.g. homeRuns,battingAverage,earnedRunAverage.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: hitting, pitching, fielding, catching or running.

parameters.name: sport_id
parameters.description: Level: 1 MLB (default), 11 Triple-A, 12 Double-A, 13 High-A, 14 Single-A, 16 Rookie, 17 winter leagues, 51 international.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: MLB game play-by-play with every pitch
get.description:
Every plate appearance of a game in order: inning and half, result and description, RBI, score after the play, batter and pitcher, runner movement, and every pitch (call, pitch type, speed, spin rate, zone, count) with batted-ball data (exit velocity, launch angle, distance). Filter to one inning or to scoring plays; `pitches=false` leaves the pitch list out.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-play-by-play

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Game id (gamePk) from /mlb/v1/schedule, or an mlb.com gameday link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

plays.description: Yandy Díaz reaches on a throwing error by shortstop Cooper Pratt. Yandy Díaz to 2nd.

get.summary: MLB player bio, draft, awards and stats
get.description:
One player: names, number, position, bats and throws, birth date and place, height and weight, current team, debut and last game, draft picks, education, awards, and season and career hitting, pitching and fielding stats.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-player

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Player id (592450 = Aaron Judge) from search, rosters or box scores, or an mlb.com/player link.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season for the season stats (default the latest).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: MLB player stats by season, career, game log and splits
get.description:
Each split carries the season, team, opponent, game and the stat line.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-player-stats

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: hitting (default), pitching, fielding, catching, running; comma-separated for several.

parameters.name: last
parameters.description: Number of games for lastXGames / gameLog.

parameters.name: opponent_id
parameters.description: Opponent team id or abbreviation for vsTeam.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Players whose name matches: id, name, position, number, active flag, current team, birth date and country, debut, bats and throws.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-players-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a player's name (2+ characters).

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: true or false to limit to active or retired players.

parameters.name: sport_id
parameters.description: Level: 1 MLB (default), 11 Triple-A, 12 Double-A, 13 High-A, 14 Single-A, 16 Rookie, 17 winter leagues, 51 international.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: MLB team roster (active, 40-man, depth chart, coaches)
get.description:
A team's roster: player id, name, jersey number, position, status, bats and throws, age, birth date and country, height, weight and debut date. Types: active (default), 40Man, fullSeason, fullRoster, depthChart, allTime, coach, nonRosterInvitees, gameday.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-roster

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: MLB schedule and scores for a date or range
get.description:
Games for one date (default today) or a range of up to 31 days: teams, score, winner, records, probable pitchers, venue, series, status, line score by inning and the winning, losing and save pitchers. Filter by team and game type; minor leagues by `sport_id`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-schedule

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Range end (YYYY-MM-DD), at most 31 days after start_date.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Team id (147) or abbreviation (nyy, lad, bos ...).

parameters.name: game_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: R regular season, S spring training, P postseason (all rounds), F wild card, D division series, L league championship, W World Series, A All-Star, E exhibition.

parameters.name: sport_id
parameters.description: Level: 1 MLB (default), 11 Triple-A, 12 Double-A, 13 High-A, 14 Single-A, 16 Rookie, 17 winter leagues, 51 international.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: MLB standings by division, wild card or league
get.description:
Standings for a season: wins, losses, percentage, games back, wild-card games back, division/league/wild-card rank, runs scored and allowed, run differential, streak, elimination and magic numbers, clinch flags, split records (home, away, last ten, extra innings, one-run games, by month ...) and records against each division. Optionally as of a date.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-standings

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: MLB stat leaderboard with sorting and filters
get.description:
A sortable leaderboard of player stat lines for a season (or career): any sort stat, order, qualified / all / rookie pools, by team, league and position, standard, advanced, sabermetric or expected stats. Page with `offset`: pass `next_offset` back; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-stats

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: season (default), seasonAdvanced, sabermetrics, expectedStatistics, career, careerAdvanced.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Stat to sort by, e.g. homeRuns, avg, ops, era, strikeOuts, whip (default ops for hitting, era for pitching).

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: C, 1B, 2B, 3B, SS, LF, CF, RF, OF, DH, P, SP, RP.

parameters.name: sport_id
parameters.description: Level: 1 MLB (default), 11 Triple-A, 12 Double-A, 13 High-A, 14 Single-A, 16 Rookie, 17 winter leagues, 51 international.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: MLB team with record and recent and next games
get.description:
One team: names, league and division, venue with location and field dimensions, this season's record (wins, losses, games back, ranks, streak, runs) and its last and next games.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-team

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Team id (147) or abbreviation (nyy, lad, bos ...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

parameters.name: sport_id

get.summary: MLB transactions (signings, trades, injured list moves)
get.description:
Roster transactions in a date range of up to 31 days (default the last 7 days): date, effective date, type, description, player and the teams involved. Filter by team.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mlb-transactions

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
